lines.trans: Hello! I'm not a journalist. I'm the head of Ivan Samsonov's campaign.
I've come to bring you our deepest apologies.
Now that is nerve! You are not blind, after all.
Do you see what he did here? He will lose the election now!
No, our candidate is very ashamed of this.
Why are we even listening? That bribe-taker Anikeev is with them!
Arkady Borisovich is a very experienced politician. And he didn't take bribes.
He always supported disabled people!
For fifteen years we've been asking for a new building! Anikeev came here in person, and what?

words.gloss: ask for, have been asking for

lines.trans: Whereas Pavel Yuryevich helped us! Today he promised to build us a new building.
Therefore we will support him!
Hello, Arkady! The blind people hate you. Where did you put their money for the new building?
I allocated it to them two years ago! I signed the order myself!
Then why are they in the old building? Osipenko said that you took the money!
What nonsense? That means Osipenko stole that money himself!
